source: IFRC Emergency Field Manual / WHO Flood Response Guidelines

translations.en: Evacuate all occupants to highest available ground immediately. Do not wait for water to recede.
translations.bi: Tekemaot olgeta man long haus, kaem go antap long haes graon naoia. No wet wota i go daon fastaem.
translations.tpi: Kisim olgeta man i go antap long graun hait nau. No wet bilong wara i go daon pastaim.
translations.ht: Evakye tout moun nan lokal la nan zòn ki pi wo a imedyatman. Pa tann dlo a desann.

translations.en: Request watercraft or rope-assisted rescue for anyone stranded above flood level.
translations.bi: Askem bot oa rop risket long ol man we oli stuk antap long wota.
translations.tpi: Askim bot o rop i helpim ol man i stap antap long wara.
translations.ht: Mande bato oswa sekou ak kòd pou moun ki rèste bloke anlè nivo dlo a.

translations.en: Flag this location for cholera and waterborne disease risk assessment within 24 hours.
translations.bi: Makem ples ia blong risk assessment blong kolera mo sik blong wota insaed long 24 haos.
translations.tpi: Makim dispela ples long risk assessment bilong kolera na sik bilong wara insait long 24 aua.
translations.ht: Make kote sa a pou evalyasyon risk kolera ak maladi ki transmèt pa dlo nan 24 èdtan.

translations.en: Count and record number of households affected. Note any vulnerable groups: elderly, children under 5, pregnant women.
translations.bi: Kaontem mo raetedown namba blong haos we oli afekted. Tingting long ol vulnerable gru: ol man we oli olfala, ol pikinini andaset faef yia, ol woman we oli gat bel.
translations.tpi: Kauntim na raitim namba bilong haus i afektim. Luksave long ol grup i winim: ol lapun, ol pikinini aninit long 5 yia, ol meri i gat bel.
translations.ht: Konte epi anrejistre kantite kay ki afekte. Note nenpòt gwoup vilnerab: granmoun, timoun anba 5 an, fanm ansent.

translations.en: Identify nearest dry shelter location. Confirm capacity can accommodate all evacuees.
translations.bi: Faenemaot klosestaem plaes blong draea shelter. Mekem sua we hemi save holem olgeta man we oli kambak.
translations.tpi: Painim klostu ples i drai bilong shelter. Konfomim olsem ples inap holim olgeta manmeri i kam.
translations.ht: Idantifye kote abri sèk ki pi pre a. Konfime kapasite ka akomode tout moun ki evacye.
